cohort: The study included 234 pregnant women after 20 weeks of gestation with hypertensive disorders in pregnancy (HDP).
finding: The HDP group with oligohydramnios or FGR had higher impaired Doppler findings, higher cesarean section rates, and lower neonatal birth weight compared to the group with normal AFI and fetal growth, with the combined oligohydramnios/FGR group showing the most severe complications.
mod_finding: The HDP group with oligohydramnios or FGR had higher cesarean section rates, which were even higher in the combined oligohydramnios/FGR group.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was lower in the HDP group with oligohydramnios/FGR compared to the group with normal AFI and fetal growth.
gest_age: Participants were pregnant women after 20 weeks of gestation.
